''See also: [[Imperial Palace (Elder Empire) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Imperial]] Palace is a massive, highly opulent complex located within the [[Capital]] of the [[Aurelian Empire]]. Occupying approximately one-fifth of the city's total area, it is so vast that it is often described as a city in its own right. The palace serves as the seat of imperial power and contains various specialized structures, including the Emperor's Stage—a three-story building with a balcony used for addressing large crowds in a massive courtyard—and the [[Rose Tower]], one of several seven-story white towers situated along its perimeter. The interior is characterized by extreme wealth, featuring expensive wood paneling and intricate floor tiles. Historically, the palace has been a central hub for imperial administration and defense. It houses the Emperor's personal quarters, his [[private armory]], and a ceremonial throne room that serves as a symbol of [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]]. Hidden within the Emperor's private chambers is the [[Optasia]], his true throne; this device was designed to amplify and broadcast his power across the world via a global network of receptors, allowing him to monitor and combat [[Great Elders]] from a distance. The palace is also home to tens of thousands of staff and inhabitants, many of whom live distinct lives from the general population of the [[Capital]]. While it is heavily protected by the [[Imperial Guard]], the palace has faced significant threats, including being targeted by [[Elders]] and experiencing internal chaos during periods of instability.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Imperial]] Palace is a massive complex that functions like its own city, housing the [[Emperor's personal rooms]] and armory. [[Calder]] and his crew traveled to the location, where [[Calder]] was eventually released alongside [[Jerri]]. While [[Calder]] currently resides within the palace and feels at home there, the site has recently been subject to various attacks. The complex serves as the only vantage point from which the [[Optasia]] is visible, though a search of its grounds yielded no trace of [[Meia]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Imperial]] Palace is a vast complex of buildings that occupies nearly one-fifth of the [[Capital]]. Within this massive structure, a tower featuring columns stands a hundred feet above the ground. During a period of conflict, the site became the target of an attack orchestrated by a [[Consultant]] saboteur. In response to these threats, the palace was held by both the Guard and the [[Navigators]].}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Imperial]] Palace is the site of an attack by a [[Consultant]] saboteur.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c15">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Imperial]] Palace is a massive complex of red-tiled roofs that occupies nearly twenty percent of the [[Capital]] and contains various dungeons. After [[Calder]] returned to the grounds, he was kept under observation while a procession took place within the complex. The site serves as the location for the Emperor's Stage and is protected such that any [[Elderspawn]] attempting to crash through its walls would be annihilated. Following a battle and [[Calder]]'s march toward the structure, the palace fell, leaving its flagstones spotted with the blood of [[Baldezar Kern]]. While [[Kelarac]] had previously used the palace to imprison [[Jerri]], the site may have been taken by the [[Independents]] after its collapse, an event tied to [[Calder]]'s death.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">15</span></div>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Imperial]] Palace is a large, roofed structure located in the [[Capital]] and is separated from the city by a wall containing the [[Rose Tower]]. Within its walls, chaos once erupted during battles where [[Gardeners]] fought and died, though the [[Elderspawn]] could be flushed out of the premises. The palace features rooms impervious to eavesdropping due to centuries of [[Intent]], and its depths serve as the residence for [[Tyria]]. During various events, [[Shera]] traveled across the red-tiled rooftops and [[Gardeners]] moved along them as well, while the [[Awakened bell]]'s ring echoed throughout the grounds. While the [[Imperialists]] utilized tunnels to escape the complex, a conference was eventually held in one of its broad rooms amidst a filling silver-blue mist.}}
